x1_operational_negatives.observed: The initial combined deferred-tool discovery call exceeded its bounded timeout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Proceed with the already available local tools and discover only an exact missing capability when required.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not bundle unrelated tool discovery into one cold call.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A broad D-drive and worktree discovery probe exceeded its bounded timeout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use the exact source and intended D-first target paths from the verified activation.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Prefer exact literal paths over drive-wide discovery.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: PowerShell rejected a direct foreach block piped to JSON serialization.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Materialize the foreach results into an array before piping.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement in this host.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A Get-Content first-and-last projection serialized provider metadata instead of the intended scalar lines.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use System.IO.File.ReadAllLines and explicit scalar indexing.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Use .NET scalar file APIs for bounded Windows text projections.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: Oversized parallel baton chunks exceeded the readable tool-output envelope.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Verify the complete file by byte hash, structural section counts, first and last lines, and the already delivered live content.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Keep file-display chunks small even when the underlying file read succeeds.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A recursive AGENTS.md filesystem search exceeded its bounded timeout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use the committed Git index to resolve applicable AGENTS.md files.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Prefer Git's exact tracked-file index to a recursive archive walk.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A receipt projection repeated the direct foreach-to-pipeline PowerShell syntax fault.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Materialize receipt rows before JSON serialization.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Apply the known foreach materialization recurrence guard consistently.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A script inventory repeated the direct foreach-to-pipeline PowerShell syntax fault.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Materialize script inventory rows before JSON serialization.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat parser recurrence as retained evidence rather than erasing the repeated witness.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The installed .NET runtime did not expose SHA256.HashData.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use the supported Get-FileHash SHA-256 implementation.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Probe runtime-supported hashing surfaces before using newer static methods.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A thirty-second committed-file lookup returned the no-AGENTS result but crossed the wrapper deadline.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Repeat the exact tracked-file lookup with a bounded longer envelope and preserve the first attempt at zero credit.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Separate returned partial evidence from command completion credit.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A broad text search matched a minified Method Flow ledger and produced unusably expansive output.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Parse exact JSON properties or query exact files instead of matching minified ledgers.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Never use free-text search over compact single-line evidence ledgers.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first source-receipt projection requested nonexistent generic phase and head keys and returned null values.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Enumerate each receipt's declared properties before projecting its phase-specific fields.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat each receipt schema as explicit rather than assuming cross-phase property names.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first frozen-index projection assumed proposals or entries instead of prior_proposals and new_proposals.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Join the two declared proposal arrays after property discovery.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Inspect JSON property names before count or semantic projections.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The worktree-add wrapper timed out while its exact Git process continued an initializing checkout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Do not retry; inspect the exact administrative lock, process tree, target marker, branch, and index until the original process completes.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: A wrapper timeout never proves a worktree mutation failed or stopped.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A combined target-path, Git-head, branch, and full status audit timed out during the active checkout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Split filesystem marker, head, branch, index, process, and cleanliness checks.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not run full status while an initializing worktree process is active.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: A full repository worktree-list audit timed out during the active checkout.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Read the exact worktree administrative directory derived from the target .git marker.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Use exact administrative records instead of enumerating all archive worktrees.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first x1 build found the THOS, SCITT, and C2PA proposal titles too similar to Caelen's corresponding frozen templates and stopped before artifact generation.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Retitle the three proposals around their coffee-specific mechanisms while preserving approval classes, evidence lanes, falsifiers, rollbacks, and protected gates.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat domain substitution alone as insufficient novelty for reusable framework proposal titles.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first independent PowerShell JSON parse attempted to use System.Text.Json.JsonDocument, which is unavailable in this host runtime.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use ConvertFrom-Json for the independent PowerShell parse and retain Python's exact JSON parsing as the phase-native validator.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Probe PowerShell runtime types before choosing a secondary JSON parser.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The x1 builder's Python subprocess could not execute the Windows Codex launcher and returned WinError 5 after a separate PowerShell version probe had succeeded.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Bind the sanitized PowerShell-observed Codex CLI version into the environment receipt without launching Codex from Python.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Verify Windows command shims from their working host surface and pass only the sanitized observation to builders.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first exact staged-blob audit found two Python files whose CRLF working bytes differed from Git's LF-cleaned index bytes.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Hash the exact Git-clean candidate blob for every manifest entry and keep working-tree line endings outside the immutable content assertion.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: A commit manifest must bind the bytes Git will store, not an unfiltered working-tree representation.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first compound PowerShell line-ending diagnostic was rejected by the command policy before execution.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Replace it with small read-only Git attribute, index, raw-hash, and filtered-hash probes.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Prefer narrowly composed diagnostic commands over temporary-file or deeply nested shell projections.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The scoped x1 unstage command completed, but the appended broad status count crossed the wrapper deadline.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Verify the exact staged and untracked path subsets independently and do not replay the completed index mutation.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Separate index mutation from large-worktree status enumeration and audit completion before retry.

x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first Git-clean manifest rebuild computed a filtered object identifier without writing the object, so cat-file could not read the candidate bytes and the build stopped.
x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Materialize each exact filtered blob with hash-object write mode before reading its bytes; staging will reference the same immutable object.
x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not assume a hash-object identifier is already present in the object database unless it was written or otherwise reachable.
